Master heartbeat gaps

Only the master's heartbeat on 700 is checked. A gap is the time from one heartbeat to the next; the red marks on the slider show where they are. The monitor keeps only part of the traffic, so a gap here may be the monitor dropping frames rather than the device going quiet; the count of frames the monitor saw in that second is shown to help judge.

    Emergency codes: what the drives send, what the Logfather logs show, what Grafana holds

    Every "Warning update" line from the actuator controller in Elastic is one emergency frame from a drive (COB-ID 081 to 086), decoded. The log's error_code field is the emergency code; the text after "::" is the controller's reading of the manufacturer byte. Confirmed against the 8 September capture.

    Emergency codeManufacturer byteValue bytesElastic "Warning update" textGrafanaMeaning
    0xFF8046 / 47 / 48Power Stage Controller Error :: Current Limit Phase A / B / CnoneOne motor phase hit the drive's hardware current limit and was clamped. A warning, not a trip.
    0xFF8026Power Stage Controller Error :: Hardware error (driver error)nonePower stage fault in the drive.
    0xFF0038Device specific :: Motor Encoder disconnectednoneThe drive lost its motor encoder, typically during a brownout.
    0xFF00otherDevice specific :: Gear Encoder disconnected, Over ForcenoneOther device-specific faults.
    0x312040float, supply voltsDS401: Input voltage too low :: Under Voltagenone (timeline condition "Under Voltage" in the Logfather)Drive supply below its limit; about 35 V during the 8 September E-Stop.
    0x81301Bfloat, ms without heartbeatLife Guard Error or Heartbeat Error :: N/AnoneThe drive stopped hearing the master's heartbeat (1,501 ms on 8 September).
    0x8120CAN Passive Mode :: CAN Tx passivebehaviour_canbus_errors (per-window counts)The drive's CAN controller went error-passive: too many transmit errors.
    0x8140recovered from bus off :: CAN transmit bus is offbehaviour_canbus_errors, _errors_near_power_eventThe drive dropped off the bus and came back.
    0x8611Position controller following errornoneThe motor could not follow the commanded position.
    0x1000Generic Error :: Emergency buffer is fullnoneThe drive had more emergencies queued than it can hold.
    0x0000Error Reset or No Error :: <what cleared>none (timeline condition "N/A error")A previous error has cleared; the text names it. Marks the end of a fault, not a fault.

    Not an emergency: the controller's own "Fault on motor :: Current limit exceeded :: Current over limit" (state high_current_error) is the software trip that stops the run; it appears in Grafana as a step in actuators_motor_halting_errors. Motor current and temperature in Grafana are one reading every 30 s of the status block the master reads from each drive about 56 times a second (object 0x2014:01).
